messages:
Aisha Patel: Heads up — we're going to change the config-preview telemetry sampling from a flat 1% to an adaptive windowed sampler tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Main goal: avoid dashboard spikes when cohort hashes shift and a bunch of tenants suddenly emit preview metrics at once. @Matt Li can infra quotas handle short bursts? :thinking:

Matt Li: We can, but need a guardrail. Suggest per-tenant burst cap + global smoothing token bucket. If sudden surge > 5x baseline for a tenant, drop to graceful attenuation.

Leo Gomez: Agreed. Also, prefer sampling that considers both recent QPS and last-sent-sample age. Otherwise low-QPS tenants will get starved and high-QPS will oversample.

Priya Shah: UX note — Console dashboards show 'preview-sample-rate' per cohort. If we change sampling dynamically we should emit the active sampling rate as a metric so cost dashboards and rollouts reflect true volume. Otherwise cost alarms will be misleading.

Aisha Patel: Good call. Plan: implement adaptive algorithm + metric emission (preview_sampling.active_rate) + audit log of sampling decisions. Minimal rollout: opt-in to 10% of tenants, monitor 24h, then expand.

Matt Li: Implementation sketch:
```yaml
sampling:
  algorithm: adaptive_window
  base_rate: 0.01
  max_rate: 0.2
  window_seconds: 600
  qps_weight: 0.6
  age_weight: 0.4
  burst_cap_per_tenant: 1000
```
We can add a backfill throttle in the collector to avoid alert storms.

Priya Shah: For dashboards, add a derived panel that shows estimated token-volume delta vs previous baseline when sampling shifts — helps Product decide if we need to pause.

Leo Gomez: One more safety: when cohorts are rehashed (rolling cohort salt change), temporarily pin sampling to previous effective_rate for 5 minutes to avoid double-counting spikes.

Aisha Patel: Nice. I'll open a small RFC later today and add a runbook checklist: preflight queries to validate telemetry emission, an ops mute window, and a rollback flag if cost or latency > threshold.

deploy-bot: scheduled job 'preview-sampling/dryrun' will run at 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z (dry-run mode).

Matt Li: If dry-run looks clean, I'll wire the token-bucket and burst cap in the collector. Will ping once done. :thumbsup:

Priya Shah: I'll add the dashboard panels and an alert that triggers if estimated token delta > 30% or any cohort sees >3x sampling variance in 15m.

Aisha Patel: Thanks team — syncing in #eng-platform tomorrow 09:30 UTC to review the dry-run graphs. Keep notes in the RFC thread.
